known_findings.finding: authenticated has SELECT privilege on public.platform_api_keys.key_hash; anon does not.
known_findings.recommended_action: Review and apply the already-reviewed candidate column-grant hardening migration only after separate explicit approval and a fresh disposable rehearsal.

known_findings.finding: anon and authenticated have no SELECT or INSERT table privilege on public.billing_webhook_events.
known_findings.recommended_action: Preserve the service-only access model unless application requirements and a reviewed threat model prove otherwise.

known_findings.finding: authenticated lacks direct UPDATE privilege on public.profiles.role.
known_findings.recommended_action: Retain server-controlled role assignment; do not add client write access.

known_findings.finding: All 14 inventoried public tables have RLS enabled; none has FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.
known_findings.recommended_action: Review policies, grants, ownership, SECURITY DEFINER functions, and actual role behavior; RLS enabled alone is not a complete security proof.

provenance.method: Read-only PostgreSQL catalog queries through the connected Supabase project integration.

limitations: This is a point-in-time metadata evidence summary, not a canonical, exhaustive, replayable schema contract.
The catalog capture did not persist every column, constraint, index, policy, grant, routine, and trigger definition as a complete normalized artifact.
RLS enablement does not prove policy correctness or prevent privileged-role bypass.
The candidate API-key migration has not been applied to the live project.
The reconstructed Phase 52.1D baseline remains disposable-only and noncanonical.
No application data, secret values, production changes, deployment, or live migration was performed.
